Gautam Gambhir Criticizes Guwahati Pitch After High-Scoring Match

Former cricketer Gautam Gambhir has criticized the pitch at the Guwahati stadium following a match where 811 runs were scored between India and the West Indies. Gambhir stated that the pitch was 'not cricket' and offered little assistance to bowlers, suggesting it was too lifeless for a competitive game.
